text: {"status":"partial","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview describes the initiative as aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s1","quote":"Almamlaka TV is launching a new initiative called the Digital Expansion Initiative (DEI), aimed at modernizing the channel's digital presence across streaming, mobile, and social platforms."}]},{"text":"However, the Platform Scope section lists three main platforms: the mobile application, the web streaming portal, and third-party smart TV integration, without naming any social media platform.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p2-s4","quote":"The initiative covers three main platforms: the Almamlaka TV mobile application (iOS and Android), the web streaming portal, and integration with third-party smart TV platforms."}]}],"conflicts":[],"missing":["The documents don't name any specific social media platform or describe social media work within the initiative's scope."],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
